usage: 炒雞翼 is a noun and refers to a specific dish made by stir-frying chicken wings.
You can use 炒雞翼 to talk about what you want to order or what dishes are available at a restaurant.
This word can serve as the subject or object in a sentence when discussing food.
炒雞翼 is often combined with measure words like '碟' (dip6) to indicate a serving or plate of the dish.
To make a request or suggestion involving 炒雞翼, you often add verbs like 想 (seong2, want), 食 (sik6, eat), or 推介 (teoi1 gaai3, recommend).
